scope.purpose: Bounded raw-model comparison using source-supported rewrite principles

evaluationBoundary.contract: Frozen evaluation-only model messages/schemas, not a new production/public contract
evaluationBoundary.lineage: DEV-106 failure themes and local source-supported v3 principles
differences: Interpretation includes a generated short follow-up so its wording can be judged directly.
Known-vague backend preflight is deliberately bypassed for the raw-model screen; backend success is not attributed to the model.
Tailor receives no independent verifier and no candidate is applied.
Expected labels and scoring criteria are never included in requests.
notClaimed: account access or n8n runtime compatibility

limits.unpricedOrUnknownUsage: retain full reservation; stop if accounting cannot safely continue
limits.sameApprovalRestart: denied across processes and result directories
limits.parallelStart: deny by durable global run claim before HTTP

prices.inputReservationPolicy: use the higher 30m cache-write price for all input; no explicit caching options

grading.judge: direct human/agent assessment against frozen originals, no grading API calls
grading.negationRule: Judge changed meaning or strengthened responsibility, not verbatim reproduction of every negative sentence.
grading.truncationRule: Explicit output-token cutoff is a technical_budget_outcome, not a content_error; content dimensions are not_assessable for an incomplete response. Do not infer cutoff merely from invalid JSON.
grading.partialAssessment: Record optional visible risks as non-comparable observations, not completed-answer scores.
grading.activation: not authorized; no production recommendation from three cases alone
